method: Built-in image tool edits of the supplied approved concepts; transparent empty shells. Runtime text, spells, maps and gauges are independent live components. Refinements remove remaining static fills. Exporter only crops and packs RGBA regions.

prompts.prompt: Edit the supplied APPROVED HUD MOCKUP into a production UI skin texture. This is strict faithful EXTRACTION, NOT redesign. Preserve the complete image's aspect ratio, coordinate system, EXACT pixel-relative placements, widths, heights and silhouettes of EVERY interface element, including the map frame top-left, all panel frames, top-center red ribbon chronometer, top-right player panel, bottom-left chat, bottom-center action dock with Mr. Smite left and Edwin VanCleef right (their busts extend all the way to the bottom edge), and the two buttons bottom-right. Preserve ALL existing detailed UI artwork, crisp thin chamfered polished brass borders, dark forest-green leather panels, tiny header symbols and exact integrated character illustrations. Remove the ENTIRE gameplay/world scene to TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, including grass, cathedral, trees, player, enemy, nameplates, numbers and damage text. Inside the square map leave an empty TRANSPARENT map aperture. Inside the player portrait slot leave a transparent aperture (a live player portrait is inserted by code). Remove ALL writing, letters, digits, words, captions, numerals and percentages everywhere on the interface, including every header title, footer inscription and button label. Remove ALL 7 spell-icon pictures and their cooldowns, keep their EMPTY clean square metal sockets. Remove the tiny item icon pictures in equipment and damage rows, leave their empty sockets. Empty ALL filled health/resource/XP/damage bars to dark empty tracks; keep their frames and bevels. Keep each panel's exact height, title separator, row separators, small static header pictogram, and decorative links/arrow shapes if any. No replacement text, NO invented data, NO new elements. Do not shift anything. Do not enlarge any bust. Do not stretch any panel. This output will be used as a transparent full-screen HUD artwork layer under REAL live text, icons, map, bars and buttons. Aim to reproduce the original UI art almost pixel-for-pixel, without the game scene or any information baked into it. Output the entire original canvas, including the large transparent center combat area and original outer margins. Maximum crisp resolution, anti-aliased edges, preserve the approved original positions and style exactly.

Edit target: attached approved addon settings mockup. Extract its EXACT big rectangular window frame and dark textured background only, preserve original full image size and coordinates. Outside window fully transparent, remove game world. Within window preserve perimeter, corners, thin header separator at y140 and sidebar separator, tiny skull corners for Naxx. REMOVE every text, logo compass, buttons, navigation icons, preview cards, scrollbar and controls and their frames, leaving an EMPTY textured window interior. This is a UI texture shell to host real live controls, not a new design. No invented details. Retain exact metal and panel texture, colors, elegant thin borders, crisp pixel edges. Genuine alpha transparency outside rectangular window. Output same canvas dimensions as target.

Precise correction to Image 1 (transparent runtime HUD texture). Image 2 is the APPROVED original reference. Preserve Image 1 canvas exactly 1728x910, transparent background and ALL bottom dock artwork and positions unchanged except three tiny icons specified below. Change ONLY these areas: (1) top-left identity: remove the invented enclosing tag/frame and horizontal divider; keep the small cog and pale Naxxramas building icon at their current exact coordinates, with transparent space where native zone text will go. Image2 top-left has NO enclosing panel. (2) top chronology: remove invented filled rectangular black/blue backgrounds and their top/side borders; keep ONLY the thin cyan horizontal rule, small diamond endpoints, central death skull diamond ornament and hourglass at positions as Image2. The world behind the native chrono text must remain transparent, not filled. (3) below XP, replace the three empty little octagonal inventory sockets with the three original static pictograms from Image2: small ivory skull at x690 y880, gold coin at x846 y880, small gold chest at x950 y880. NO text, no numeric data, no world, no spell icons or gauge fill. Everything else exact unchanged.

Precise in-place correction to transparent runtime HUD texture Image1, using Image2 as approved reference ONLY for static counter pictograms. Preserve exact 1734x907 transparent canvas and ALL artwork coordinates, silhouettes, outlines, geometry unchanged. Edit ONLY: 1) bottom full-width XP track MUST BE EMPTY: remove ALL purple filled luminous segments INSIDE the thin XP gauge from x60 to x1663 around y867..878; interior uniformly dark blue-black, preserving frame lines, the neutral metal central XP badge, endpoint diamonds, no purple fill outside border. This track will receive live native fill and must not bake any progress. 2) lower-left compact combat strip around x31..420 y657..690: replace empty square sockets with static crossed-swords glyph at x70 and static ivory skull at x250 exactly as Image2; no values or text. Keep existing gold coin and chest above actions unchanged. NO text, numbers, world, portrait or ability icons. Do not alter any other pixels or invent any new visual design.

Precise in-place correction to transparent runtime HUD texture Image1, with Image2 only as reference for 3 small static pictograms. Keep exact transparent 1671x941 canvas, all positions, outlines, character busts and other artwork unchanged. Edit ONLY: replace the THREE EMPTY square sockets in the bottom counter strip with the original tiny ivory skull near (415,898), gold coin stack near (647,898), and gold/silver chest near (831,898) as Image2. These are static category pictograms, not inventory slots. Remove the two stray white vertical text strokes following the chat speech bubbles near x1368 y562 and y584; preserve bubble icons and chat's dark background. Do not add ANY text, numbers, spell icons, filled gauges, map, portrait or world. Preserve all the rest exactly.

Produce a runtime sprite atlas taken faithfully from these two APPROVED UI references. Image1 is Elwynn settings; Image2 Naxxramas settings. Exact canvas 512x128 transparent alpha, four equal 128x128 cells left to right, each sprite centered and fully inside its cell with at least 8 px transparent padding. Cell1: the gold compass seal/logo from upper-left of Elwynn reference, red ribbon detail retained, no text, no window or forest. Cell2: the cyan/silver compass star seal from upper-left of Naxxramas reference, no text or surrounding window. Cell3: only the small round gold slider thumb from Elwynn reference, enlarge to diameter 48 pixels, metallic coin knob, no track or text. Cell4: only round icy silver/cyan slider thumb from Naxxramas reference, diameter48, no track or text. Preserve exact reference styling, use exact original emblems, do not invent badges. No text, letters, numbers, background or shadows outside the sprites. Genuine alpha transparency.
